news_headlines.title: Halliburton announces the Xaminer logging service to optimize reservoirs
news_headlines.summary: Halliburton has launched its new Xaminer logging service, designed to optimize reservoir management, especially in geologically complex formations. The service aims to reduce technical uncertainty and improve development and completion plans by providing greater subsurface clarity through an expanded radius of investigation and enabling real-time decision-making.
